items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: I played Manny Perez in the Roof Garden.

ctx.x: Yeah, he jumped out off of a building or something. Yeah, yeah, I heard about it. Do you remember who used to play with y'all with Manny Perez? Who? Do you remember the musician was playing with y'all with Manny Perez band? Who all was in the band with Manny Perez? Manny Perez? Manny Perez? Manny Perez? I played with Manny Perez. Oh, yeah.
I played Manny Perez in the Roof Garden.
Yeah, well, who's all in the band? The members of the band? Oh, who's playing with the band? Yeah.
